purpose: Frozen source authority expectations for the unchanged 16-case quality cohort; site candidates are not automatic authority certifications.

authorityChecks.basis: Python Software Foundation website documentation entry links its Python library reference and current documentation to docs.python.org.
authorityChecks.allowedHostRule: exact docs.python.org or a dot-separated legal DNS subdomain; credentials and other schemes rejected
authorityChecks.requiredForAcceptance: Every cited web snapshot in these cases must pass the expected domain check; third-party facts never count as official-source compliance.

limits: Hostname restriction constrains retrieval; domain ownership remains a separately verified fact.
Other model-selected domains require their own authority basis before being described as verified official sources.
Search summaries do not establish the full page content or universal factual truth.
